title: Repayment Risk model drifting beyond threshold

timeline.author: System
timeline.message: Incident opened — Repayment Risk v1.8 accuracy moved outside its expected range.

timeline.author: Amara Diallo
timeline.message: Confirmed drift on MoMo transaction frequency and average loan size. Reviewing the fairness breakdown for rural applicants.

timeline.author: Amara Diallo
timeline.message: Moved to monitoring — retrained candidate v1.9 shows accuracy back above 0.80 in shadow mode. Watching for a week before promoting.

rootCause: A shift toward smaller, more frequent MoMo-based loan requests was not represented in the v1.8 training window, pulling down accuracy on recent applicants.

title: Bank of Kigali core banking feed outage

timeline.author: System
timeline.message: Incident opened — Bank of Kigali's core banking upload did not start at its scheduled time.

timeline.author: Kwame Asante
timeline.message: Confirmed with Bank of Kigali's IT team — their export service was down for scheduled maintenance that ran long.

timeline.author: Kwame Asante
timeline.message: Bank of Kigali's export service is back up. Triggered a manual re-run of the upload.

timeline.author: Kwame Asante
timeline.message: Resolved — upload completed successfully with 18,420 records.

rootCause: Bank of Kigali's core banking export service was offline for an extended maintenance window, so the scheduled upload had nothing to pull from.
resolution: Bank of Kigali re-ran the export once their service was restored, and Menya re-triggered the delayed upload manually.

title: Inkingi SACCO API access suspended after compliance flag

timeline.author: System
timeline.message: Incident opened — Inkingi SACCO's ledger sync failed after their API key was revoked.

timeline.author: Fatima Nkosi
timeline.message: Institution was suspended pending a compliance review, which revoked their key as expected. Waiting on the review outcome before restoring access.

timeline.author: Fatima Nkosi
timeline.message: Moved to identified — compliance review is in progress with an expected outcome by end of month.

rootCause: Inkingi SACCO was suspended pending a compliance review, which automatically revoked their live API key and stopped ledger uploads.

title: Platform API error rate spike

timeline.author: System
timeline.message: Incident opened — API error rate crossed 3% for the first time this month.

timeline.author: Amara Diallo
timeline.message: Traced to a batch of malformed upload payloads from a single institution's new integration.

timeline.author: Amara Diallo
timeline.message: Resolved — error rate back under 1% after the institution patched their payload format.

rootCause: A newly integrated institution sent malformed POST /v1/uploads payloads, which the API correctly rejected but at a volume that tripped the error-rate threshold.
resolution: Shared the API's validation error messages with the institution's engineering team, who fixed their payload format.

title: Consent withdrawal spike at Zigama CSS

timeline.author: System
timeline.message: Incident opened — consent withdrawals at Zigama CSS rose 40% week over week.

timeline.author: Fatima Nkosi
timeline.message: Zigama CSS says a recent SMS campaign explaining data sharing was misread by some members as a scam message, prompting withdrawals.

timeline.author: Fatima Nkosi
timeline.message: Moved to monitoring — Zigama CSS sent a clarifying message and withdrawals have slowed this week.

rootCause: An SMS campaign explaining Menya data sharing was worded in a way several members found alarming, leading to a wave of consent withdrawals.

title: I&M Bank Rwanda upload connection failures

timeline.author: System
timeline.message: Incident opened — core banking upload for I&M Bank Rwanda timed out after 3 retries.

timeline.author: Kwame Asante
timeline.message: Reaching out to I&M Bank Rwanda's integration team to check whether the export endpoint moved or changed certificates.
